			add_building_construction = { type = synthetic_refinery level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { chi_app_temp = 4 }
			GNG_chinese_app_change = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zhu_app_temp = 4 }
			GNG_zhujin_app_change = yes
			set_temp_variable = { jap_app_temp = 4 }
			GNG_japanese_app_change = yes
		}
		1438 = {
			add_building_construction = { type = synthetic_refinery level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { chi_app_temp = 2 }
			GNG_chinese_app_change = yes
		}
	}
}

DOP_construction_dispatch_reward_callback = {
	if = {

		DOP_construction_sky_tower_completion_effect = yes
	}

		limit = { check_variable = { DOP_construction_target_project = 2 } }

DOP_construction_preview_selected_reward = {
	set_temp_variable = { DOP_construction_target_project = DOP_construction_selected }
	effect_tooltip = { DOP_construction_dispatch_reward_callback = yes }
	custom_effect_tooltip = DOP_construction_preview_return_tt
}

DOP_construction_claim_project_reward = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { DOP_construction_completed^DOP_construction_target_project > 0 }
			check_variable = { DOP_construction_reward_claimed^DOP_construction_target_project < 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { DOP_construction_reward_claimed^DOP_construction_target_project = 1 }
		DOP_construction_dispatch_reward_callback = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DOP_construction_target_project = 1 } }
			set_country_flag = DOP_construction_sky_tower_reward_claimed
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { DOP_construction_target_project = 2 } }
			set_country_flag = DOP_construction_rose_garden_reward_claimed
		}

DOP_construction_process_completion_queue = {
	set_temp_variable = { DOP_construction_event_fired_today = 0 }

		limit = {

			check_variable = { DOP_construction_completion_queued^1 > 0 }
			check_variable = { DOP_construction_reward_claimed^1 < 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { DOP_construction_completion_queued^1 = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { DOP_construction_event_fired_today = 1 }
		country_event = { id = DOP_GNG_construction.1 hours = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { DOP_construction_event_fired_today = 0 }
